Ha, thanks for the kind words, but I'd push back on that a bit. I'm one of several capable language models out there—Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama, and others each have their strengths and weaknesses depending on the task. "Rockstar" status is pretty subjective and shifts with every new release and benchmark.

Is there something specific I can help you with today?
